questions.q: If set A has 3 elements and set B has 2 elements, how many elements does A × B have?
If the ordered pairs (x + 1, y − 2) and (3, 1) are equal, find x + y.
questions.e: x + 1 = 3 gives x = 2 and y − 2 = 1 gives y = 3, so x + y = 5.

questions.q: If f(x) = x² − 3x + 2, find f(4).
If n(A) = 2 and n(B) = 3, how many relations are there from A to B?
questions.e: A × B has 2 × 3 = 6 elements; every subset is a relation, so there are 2⁶ = 64 relations.

questions.q: If f(x) = 2x + 3 and g(x) = x² are real functions, find (fg)(2).
If A = {1, 2}, how many elements does A × A × A have?
The domain of the real function f(x) = (x² + 1)/(x² − 5x + 6) is R − {a, b}. Find a + b.
questions.e: x² − 5x + 6 = (x − 2)(x − 3) = 0 at x = 2 and x = 3, so the domain is R − {2, 3} and a + b = 5.

questions.q: R = {(x, y) : y = x + 5, x is a natural number less than 4}. Find the sum of all elements in the range of R.
questions.e: x = 1, 2, 3 gives y = 6, 7, 8, so the range is {6, 7, 8} and its sum is 21.

questions.q: Let A = {1, 2, 3, 4, 6} and R = {(a, b) : a, b ∈ A, b is exactly divisible by a}. How many ordered pairs are there in R?
If f(x) = x³ − 1/x³ (x ≠ 0), find the value of f(x) + f(1/x).
questions.e: f(1/x) = 1/x³ − x³, so f(x) + f(1/x) = x³ − 1/x³ + 1/x³ − x³ = 0.

questions.q: A relation R in a set A is called a ______ relation if R = A × A.
questions.e: If every element of A is related to every element of A, i.e. R = A × A, the relation is called the universal relation.

questions.q: A function f : X → Y is said to be ______ if every element of Y is the image of some element of X under f.
questions.e: f is onto (surjective) if for every y ∈ Y there exists x ∈ X with f(x) = y, i.e. range = codomain.

questions.q: How many ordered pairs are there in the identity relation on a set having 4 elements?
questions.e: The identity relation contains only the pairs (a, a), one for each element, so it has 4 pairs.

questions.q: How many equivalence relations on the set {1, 2, 3} contain the ordered pair (1, 2)?
questions.e: 1 and 2 must be in the same class: either {1, 2}, {3} or {1, 2, 3}. So there are 2 such equivalence relations.

questions.q: How many one-one functions are there from the set {1, 2, 3} to itself?
questions.e: A one-one function from a 3-element set to itself is a permutation, so there are 3! = 6.

questions.q: On A = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}, R = {(a, b) : |a − b| is even} is an equivalence relation. How many elements of A are related to 1 (including 1 itself)?
questions.e: |a − 1| is even for a = 1, 3, 5, so the equivalence class of 1 is {1, 3, 5}, which has 3 elements.

questions.q: Let R = {(1, 2), (2, 3)} be a relation on {1, 2, 3}. What is the minimum number of ordered pairs that must be added to R to make it both reflexive and transitive?
questions.e: Reflexivity needs (1,1), (2,2), (3,3); transitivity of (1,2) and (2,3) needs (1,3). The resulting set is reflexive and transitive, so 4 pairs are needed.

questions.q: How many onto functions are there from the set {1, 2, 3} to the set {a, b}?
questions.e: Total functions = 2³ = 8; the 2 constant functions are not onto, so onto functions = 8 − 2 = 6.

questions.q: How many different equivalence relations can be defined on a set with 3 elements?
questions.e: Equivalence relations correspond to partitions: {a}{b}{c}, {ab}{c}, {ac}{b}, {bc}{a}, {abc} — 5 in total.

questions.q: How many reflexive relations can be defined on a set with 3 elements?
questions.e: A × A has 9 pairs; the 3 diagonal pairs must be included and each of the other 6 may or may not be, giving 2⁶ = 64.

questions.q: What is the order of the differential equation d²y/dx² + (dy/dx)³ + y = 0?
questions.e: The highest order derivative present is d²y/dx², so the order is 2.

questions.q: What is the degree of the differential equation (d²y/dx²)³ + (dy/dx)⁴ + y = 0?
questions.e: The equation is a polynomial in derivatives; the highest order derivative d²y/dx² occurs with power 3, so the degree is 3.

questions.q: How many arbitrary constants are there in the general solution of a differential equation of order 3?
questions.e: The general solution of an nth order differential equation contains n arbitrary constants, so here 3.

questions.q: Find the sum of the order and the degree of the differential equation (d³y/dx³)² + (d²y/dx²)³ + dy/dx + y = 0.
questions.e: Highest order derivative is d³y/dx³ (order 3), and its power is 2 (degree 2); 3 + 2 = 5.

questions.q: Solve dy/dx = 2x with y(0) = 1. What is the value of y when x = 3?
questions.e: y = x² + C; y(0) = 1 gives C = 1, so y = x² + 1 and y(3) = 10.

questions.q: Solve dy/dx = y with y(0) = 2. What is the value of y when x = ln 3?
questions.e: dy/y = dx gives y = Ce^x; y(0) = 2 gives C = 2, so y = 2e^(ln 3) = 6.

questions.q: Solve the linear differential equation dy/dx + y/x = 3x (x > 0) with y(1) = 2. What is the value of y when x = 2?
questions.e: IF = x, so d(xy)/dx = 3x², giving xy = x³ + C; y(1) = 2 gives C = 1. At x = 2: 2y = 9, so y = 4.5.

questions.q: Solve the homogeneous differential equation x dy/dx = x + y (x > 0) with y(1) = 2. What is the value of y/x when x = e?
questions.e: dy/dx − y/x = 1 has IF 1/x, so d(y/x)/dx = 1/x and y/x = ln x + C; y(1) = 2 gives C = 2. At x = e, y/x = 1 + 2 = 3.

questions.q: Solve dy/dx + 2y = 4 with y(0) = 0. What is the value of y when x = ln 2?
Solve (1 + x²) dy/dx = 2xy with y(0) = 1. What is the value of y when x = 3?
questions.e: dy/y = 2x dx/(1 + x²) gives ln y = ln(1 + x²) + C; y(0) = 1 gives C = 0, so y = 1 + x² and y(3) = 10.
